description: Search memory for the EVENT, not the user's question. 1) Plain words ("who gave me jewelry?" -> query "received a gift"). 2) Keep names and exact words (aunt, тётя, Airbnb). 3) Time is date=YYYY-MM-DD (that day ±1), or since/until inclusive (one side is ok). Exact day: since=until=that day. Unknown time: time=unknown. Never guess. Do not put yesterday/last week/ago in query. 4) Computed answers ("how many months ago") use the hit date; you do the arithmetic. 5) Before/after X: find X, read its date, then search a window around that date. 6) Nothing found: rephrase, or widen ±3 days (the reply shows the call), and only then say you do not remember. Convert relative dates yourself from the conversation date. Examples: memory_search(query="received a gift", date="2023-03-04"); memory_search(query="trip", since="2023-03-01", until="2023-03-07"); memory_search(query="dentist", time="unknown"); memory_search(since="2023-03-04", until="2023-03-04"). [C v4.ef55ca:H,R02,R05m]

query.description: Search text in the memory base_language (turn/step_zero report base_language); keep names and exact terms.

search_as.description: Optional, recommended when the user asks a question about the past: up to 3 short statements of how the answer was most likely WRITTEN in memory - statement form, not a question; first person as the speaker said it ("my kids loved...", "I went to...") and third person with names; in the memory's base_language (turn/step_zero report it; translate the question if the user wrote in another language; keep names); never invent the unknown fact. Searched together with the question (finds answers a question-shaped query misses, esp. cross-language).

name: memory_search
